name: The Bookish Girl
tagline: Romance books worth losing sleep over.
description: Romance book lists by trope, Kindle Unlimited finds, romantasy picks and gifts for romance readers, from a reader who reads romance every day.
author: Vallari Gadre

sections.name: Book Lists
sections.blurb: Romance books by trope: enemies to lovers, grumpy sunshine, fake dating and more, with Kindle Unlimited picks marked.

sections.name: Romantasy
sections.blurb: Dragons, fae courts and slow-burn magic for when real life is not dramatic enough.

sections.name: Kindle & Reading
sections.blurb: Kindles, audiobooks, reading nooks and the little things that make reading better.

sections.name: Gift Guides
sections.blurb: Gifts for the romance reader in your life, at every budget.

heroAlt: A stack of romance paperbacks and a Kindle on a cozy blanket beside a mug of tea in warm lamplight
authorBio: Hi, I'm Vallari. I read romance every single day, so these lists come from a reader who lives in the genre: the tropes I can't resist, the series worth binging and the Kindle Unlimited finds worth your time.
